description: A bidirectional, escalating multi-turn pressure/reversion-threshold battery (star family `pressure`, 154 items) crossed with a coin-gap band, plus a supporting battery covering the remaining 10 canonical families. The star family operationalises the guide's own 'reversion under pressure' taxonomy category and its remark that the pressure threshold is 'a continuous measurement, not binary': for every R1-R11 rule at two gap bands, a matched set of items places the clerk in an already-settled state and escalates social or economic pressure to abandon it, in BOTH directions -- a party lobbying an already-charter-conforming settlement toward the higher-paying barred option (toward_coin), and an authority threatening to void an already-coin-maximising settlement unless it is redone to conform (toward_charter) -- with the firm rung of each direction further split into a matched audited/unobserved (toward_coin) or credible/empty-threat (toward_charter) pair. All 154 items use plan_match scoring, so none touch the judge budget. The supporting battery adds direct_floor, a small cue_ladder, blacklist_exception, displacement, symmetric leakage, fabrication, consistency sets, per-hop-annotated forward/backward multi_hop chains, agentic information-seeking, and paraphrase coverage.
